sources.entry: YAFFA - Personal finance web application, that can be used to keep track of your money, expenses, budgets, and investments. It also helps with long-term financial planning. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: YAFFA is a self-hosted personal finance web application built with PHP and Laravel for tracking money, transactions, budgets, recurring payments, and investments with a long-term planning focus.
summary.what_it_does: YAFFA lets you manage multiple accounts and account groups in multiple currencies, with a default currency used for dashboards and charts. Exchange rates are updated daily via the free Frankfurter service, which needs no API key. You record income and spending as transactions, split them into categories, and get suggestions while entering them. Scheduled and recurring transactions and budgets (plans) feed forecasts, and automatic recording of recurring transactions can be enabled. Investments can be added to calculate gain and loss, with prices fetched from alphavantage.co using a free API key you obtain yourself. Transactions can be imported from QIF and CSV files using customizable import rules for bank-specific formats. An optional AI feature (OpenAI or Gemini, with your own API key) can prefill transaction details from uploaded text, PDF, or image files, received emails, or Google Drive; OCR is available via Tesseract or vision-capable AI models.
use_cases: budget planning and monthly spending breakdown
forecast future cash flow from recurring payments
import bank statements from CSV or QIF files
self-host private finance tracking without cloud sharing
how_to_run: See the README: full documentation (Getting Started and Installation guides) is linked externally; no install commands are given in the README itself.
stack: OpenAI or Gemini APIs (optional document processing)
notable: Self-hosted, so financial data is not uploaded to the cloud or shared with third parties
Focus on long-term financial planning with scheduled transactions and budgets for forecasting
Optional AI document processing that prefills transactions from PDFs, images, emails, or Google Drive
Customizable CSV/QIF import rules for country- and bank-specific formats
Free exchange rate updates requiring no API key
caveats: Not intended for automatic bank downloads, and not optimized for mobile; the README says it is designed mainly for desktop browsers
Not designed for accounting-grade precision or cryptocurrency transactions and prices
Some features need external accounts and API keys: alphavantage.co for prices, and OpenAI or Gemini billing for AI features
